commands.command: e=.planning/phases/14.2-trustworthy-weekly-table/evidence && test -s "$e/weekly.html" && grep -q "Förväntat under 4 M" "$e/weekly.html" && grep -q "Över 4 M förväntat" "$e/weekly.html" && grep -q "nya sedan förra veckan" "$e/weekly.html" && test "$(grep -rIlE 'smtps?://[^ ]*@|sk-ant-|apify_api_[A-Za-z0-9]' "$e" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = "0" && s=.planning/phases/14.2-trustworthy-weekly-table/14.2-09-SUMMARY.md && grep -q "D-17" "$s" && grep -q "Folkungagatan 61" "$s" && grep -q "Varför här" "$s" && node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const p=".planning/phases/14.2-trustworthy-weekly-table/";const s=fs.readFileSync(p+"14.2-09-SUMMARY.md","utf8");const log=fs.readFileSync(p+"evidence/live-run.log","utf8");const t=(log.match(/^Täckning \(.*$/m)||[])[0];if(!t)throw new Error("no coverage line");const get=l=>{const m=t.match(new RegExp(l+" (\\d+) av (\\d+) \\("));if(!m)throw new Error("no item "+l);const k=+m[1],n=+m[2];if(n===0)throw new Error("0 candidates");return {k,n,below:k*100<80*n}};const sun=get("sol/orientering angiven"),cond=get("skick känt"),balc=get("balkong känd");if(sun.below&&!/not met (—|-) 14\.3 scope/.test(s))throw new Error("sun under 80 % without the 14.3 verdict");for(const [name,c] of [["skick känt",cond],["balkong känd",balc]]){if(c.below&&!(/^## Gaps/m.test(s)&&/gaps_found/.test(s)&&s.includes(name+" "+c.k+" av "+c.n)))throw new Error(name+" under 80 % but no Gaps section with gaps_found and the measured number")}console.log("D-17 gate consistent",JSON.stringify({sun,cond,balc}))' && t=$(git ls-files "$e") && test "$(printf '%s\n' "$t" | grep -c .)" -ge 4 && test -z "$(git ls-files .planning/calibration/data)"
commands.statement: evidence HTML missing, lacking either section or the "nya sedan förra veckan" label; a secret pattern in evidence; SUMMARY lacks the D-17 checklist, Folkungagatan 61 or the reason column; the W1 gate check fails (sun under 80 % without "not met — 14.3 scope", or condition / balcony under 80 % without a "## Gaps" section containing gaps_found and the measured "k av N"); fewer than four committed evidence files; anything under .planning/calibration/data tracked
commands.task: Task 3: Commit the evidence and write the honest D-17 readout
